articles.title: COLORSHOXX Venom Shift

articles.what: Toxic green ↔ black purple — green zones pop metallic, purple stays dark and menacing. Aggressive shift. Up close: Near-black with fine steep diagonal hairlines picked out in dark green dashes, and sparse soft squarish smudges of dim green and a few purple-edged ones. Low contrast; the colour is a dark green-black rather than any visible green. From a distance: Reads as black with a dark moss-green undertone; the pops and the purple shadow are not obvious until light hits at an angle. Measured spec (average): metal 116, roughness 128, coat 54. Shine: semi-matte. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.

Open the AI copilot (the ✦ AI button, bottom right) and ask for it by name, for example "put COLORSHOXX Venom Shift on the hood".
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.

Whole body for a full venom look

Pairs well with: black, lime, chrome, purple.
Not listed in the picker: ask the AI copilot for it by name.

Not Phantom Violet: green pops on a more matte and more metallic base
Avoid: green numbers blend into the green flash, next to other loud shift finishes.
